mode.title: Run mode
mode.description: fixture = push the bundled sample-items.json (for local testing). scrape = pull live ads from Jobnet.dk's BFF search API.

searchString.title: Search string
searchString.description: Free-text query passed to Jobnet's search (e.g. 'marketing'). Empty = all ads.

maxItems.title: Max items per run
maxItems.description: Soft cap so dev runs don't pull all ~23k ads.
